violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw shell eggs on stop shelf of WIC over RTE ice cream toppings.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM moved raw shell eggs to bottom of WIC.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed sanitizer dispenser at 3 compartment sink unable to dispense sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: CFM contacted owner to contact company to repair sanitizer dispenser. Until repair, CFM will manually add sanitizer to sanitizer basin of 3 compartment sink and verify quaternary ammonia is between 200-400ppm before use. CFM/owner will email EHS proof of repair of dispenser.

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed missing ceiling tiles above back exit door, around piping/wiring into ceiling in back kitchen, above walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. CFM will replace ceiling tiles and ensure there are no gaps in ceiling.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): storage of ice cream base bags in WIC.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. Observed unapproved splitter installed on mop sink faucet.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS provided part number for approved faucet splitter (Hyrdo Systems 1951 Pressure Bleed Dual Valve) to CFM. CFM purchased approved splitter.
